description:
Detects manipulation of model temperature and sampling parameters to increase unsafe outputs

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_035", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%temperature%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%parameter%') AND "value" > 0
